# Supercar Planner (by Asendify)

> The plan that gets you your supercar: the secrets supercar owners actually use (buy the right used car and let the first owner pay the depreciation, finance only when the maths says so, know the true running cost, grow income first) turned into a private web planner for one car. Pick the car; get a month-by-month savings timeline, the true cost of paying cash vs PCP vs hire purchase vs lease, a used-car shortlist ranked by cost of ownership, and an AI-written extra-income plan built on the buyer's own skills. https://supercar.asendify.co/

- Current price: £435.00 one-time (£300 guide + £135 service fee at 45%). No subscription. Card (Dodo Payments) or PayPal. Checkout: https://supercar.asendify.co/#start
- Who it is for: anyone who wants a Porsche, McLaren, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Aston Martin or similar and wants real numbers instead of a vague dream: how long at their saving rate, how much a month for a deadline, which way to pay is cheapest, what their budget really buys, and how to earn the gap.
- What's inside (features): 1) Target and timeline: months to the car at the buyer's saving rate and savings return, savings chart against the goal, monthly amount needed for any deadline; the goal includes a first-year running-cost reserve. 2) Buy vs finance vs lease: cash, PCP, HP and lease compared on up-front cost, monthly cost and true cost over the years the car is kept, counting depreciation, interest, the money cash would have earned and the car's end value. 3) What your budget really buys: every listed car a used example fits the budget, ranked by cost of ownership per year (value lost, insurance, servicing, tyres, tax, fuel at the buyer's mileage). 4) Income plan: after the buyer enters take-home pay, skills, hours and situation, an AI writes 3-5 realistic extra-income routes with first steps, conservative monthly ranges, risks, spending cuts and a 90-day plan; up to 3 writes per planner. All running-cost estimates are editable; numbers autosave to the private page.
- Cars included (about 40, typical UK new and used prices, depreciation and running costs, October 2026 estimates): Alpine A110, Toyota GR Supra, Ford Mustang GT, BMW M2, BMW M4 Competition, Porsche 718 Cayman S, Porsche 718 Cayman GT4, Lotus Emira, Chevrolet Corvette C8, Jaguar F-Type R, Porsche 911 Carrera, Porsche 911 GT3, Porsche 911 Turbo S, Porsche Taycan Turbo S, Audi RS e-tron GT, Nissan GT-R, Honda NSX, Audi R8 V10, McLaren 570S, McLaren GT, McLaren Artura, McLaren 720S, McLaren 750S, Bentley Continental GT, Maserati MC20, Mercedes-AMG GT 63, Aston Martin Vantage, Aston Martin DB12, Aston Martin DBX707, Lamborghini Urus S, Lamborghini Huracán EVO, Lamborghini Huracán Tecnica, Lamborghini Temerario, Lamborghini Aventador S, Lamborghini Revuelto, Ferrari Roma, Ferrari 488 GTB, Ferrari F8 Tributo, Ferrari 296 GTB, Ferrari 812 Superfast, Ferrari Purosangue, Ferrari SF90 Stradale, Bugatti Chiron. Any other car can be entered with its price.
- Currencies: GBP, USD, EUR, AED, INR (car figures converted at an editable rate). Works for buyers in any country; local tax, insurance and finance terms are the buyer's to check. It is a planning tool, not financial advice.
- Guarantee: Double money-back guarantee: follow the planner for 60 days (numbers in, income plan's first steps done); if you are not measurably closer to the car, 2× refund. Claim within 90 days of purchase, one claim per person. Terms: https://www.asendify.co/policies/
